001
002package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node;
003
004import java.net.URI;
005
006import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.IMetapathExpression;
007import dev.metaschema.core.model.IAssemblyDefinition;
008import dev.metaschema.core.model.IAssemblyInstance;
009import dev.metaschema.core.model.IAssemblyInstanceGrouped;
010import dev.metaschema.core.model.IFieldDefinition;
011import dev.metaschema.core.model.IFieldInstance;
012import dev.metaschema.core.model.IFlagDefinition;
013import dev.metaschema.core.model.IFlagInstance;
014import dev.metaschema.core.model.IModule;
015import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
016import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
017
018/**
019 * This factory interface is used to create {@link INodeItem} objects of various
020 * types.
021 * <p>
022 * A singleton instance of this factory can be acquired using the
023 * {@link #instance()} method.
024 */
025public interface INodeItemFactory {
026
027  /**
028   * Get the singleton instance of the default node factory.
029   *
030   * @return the node factory instance
031   */
032  @NonNull
033  static INodeItemFactory instance() {
034    return DefaultNodeItemFactory.instance();
035  }
036
037  /**
038   * Create a new document node item for the provided {@code definition}.
039   *
040   * @param definition
041   *          the root assembly definition to create the document item for.
042   * @param documentUri
043   *          the uniform resource identifier of the document
044   * @param value
045   *          the root item's associated data
046   * @return the new node item
047   */
048  @NonNull
049  IDocumentNodeItem newDocumentNodeItem(
050      @NonNull IAssemblyDefinition definition,
051      @NonNull URI documentUri,
052      @NonNull Object value);
053
054  /**
055   * Create a new Metaschema node item for the provided {@code metaschema}.
056   *
057   * @param module
058   *          the Metaschema to create the item for.
059   * @return the new node item
060   */
061  @NonNull
062  IModuleNodeItem newModuleNodeItem(@NonNull IModule module);
063
064  /**
065   * Create a new {@link IFlagNodeItem}, with no associated value, based on the
066   * provided flag definition.
067   *
068   * @param definition
069   *          the flag definition
070   * @param parent
071   *          the item for the Metaschema containing the definition
072   * @return the new flag node item
073   */
074  @NonNull
075  default IFlagNodeItem newFlagNodeItem(
076      @NonNull IFlagDefinition definition,
077      @NonNull IModuleNodeItem parent) {
078    return new FlagGlobalDefinitionNodeItemImpl(definition, parent);
079  }
080
081  /**
082   * Create a new {@link IFlagNodeItem} based on the provided flag instance.
083   *
084   * @param instance
085   *          the flag instance
086   * @param parent
087   *          the node item containing the flag
088   * @return the new flag node item
089   */
090  @NonNull
091  default IFlagNodeItem newFlagNodeItem(
092      @NonNull IFlagInstance instance,
093      @NonNull IModelNodeItem<?, ?> parent) {
094    return new FlagInstanceNoValueNodeItemImpl(instance, parent);
095  }
096
097  /**
098   * Create a new {@link IFlagNodeItem} based on the provided flag instance.
099   *
100   * @param instance
101   *          the flag instance
102   * @param parent
103   *          the node item containing the flag
104   * @param value
105   *          the item's associated data
106   * @return the new flag node item
107   */
108  @NonNull
109  default IFlagNodeItem newFlagNodeItem(
110      @NonNull IFlagInstance instance,
111      @NonNull IModelNodeItem<?, ?> parent,
112      @NonNull Object value) {
113    return new FlagInstanceNodeItemImpl(instance, parent, value);
114  }
115
116  /**
117   * Create a new {@link IFieldNodeItem} based on the provided definition, which
118   * is expected to be a global definition within the provided Metaschema.
119   *
120   * @param definition
121   *          the global definition
122   * @param metaschema
123   *          the Metaschema containing the definition
124   * @return the new field node item
125   */
126  @NonNull
127  IFieldNodeItem newFieldNodeItem(
128      @NonNull IFieldDefinition definition,
129      @NonNull IModuleNodeItem metaschema);
130
131  /**
132   * Create a new {@link IFieldNodeItem} that is detached from a Metaschema.
133   *
134   * @param definition
135   *          the global definition
136   * @param baseUri
137   *          the base URI to use for this node item when evaluating an
138   *          {@link IMetapathExpression}
139   * @return the new field node item
140   */
141  @NonNull
142  IFieldNodeItem newFieldNodeItem(
143      @NonNull IFieldDefinition definition,
144      @Nullable URI baseUri);
145
146  /**
147   * Create a new {@link IFieldNodeItem} that is based on a Metaschema instance.
148   * <p>
149   * A single instance of this item is expected to represent the possibility in a
150   * metaschema of a series of instance values.
151   *
152   * @param instance
153   *          the Metaschema field instance
154   * @param parent
155   *          the parent node item
156   * @return the new field node item
157   */
158  @NonNull
159  IFieldNodeItem newFieldNodeItem(
160      @NonNull IFieldInstance instance,
161      @NonNull IAssemblyNodeItem parent);
162
163  /**
164   * Create a new {@link IFieldNodeItem} that is based on a Metaschema instance
165   * with associated data.
166   *
167   * @param instance
168   *          the Metaschema field instance
169   * @param parent
170   *          the parent node item
171   * @param position
172   *          the data item's position in the sequence of data items for the
173   *          instance
174   * @param value
175   *          the item's associated data
176   * @return the new field node item
177   */
178  @NonNull
179  IFieldNodeItem newFieldNodeItem(
180      @NonNull IFieldInstance instance,
181      @NonNull IAssemblyNodeItem parent,
182      int position,
183      @NonNull Object value);
184
185  /**
186   * Create a new {@link IAssemblyNodeItem} that is detached from a Metaschema.
187   *
188   * @param definition
189   *          the global definition
190   * @return the new assembly node item
191   */
192  @NonNull
193  default IAssemblyNodeItem newAssemblyNodeItem(
194      @NonNull IAssemblyDefinition definition) {
195    return newAssemblyNodeItem(definition, (URI) null);
196  }
197
198  /**
199   * Create a new {@link IAssemblyNodeItem} based on the provided definition,
200   * which is expected to be a global definition within the provided Metaschema.
201   *
202   * @param definition
203   *          the global definition
204   * @param metaschema
205   *          the Metaschema containing the definition
206   * @return the new assembly node item
207   */
208  @NonNull
209  IAssemblyNodeItem newAssemblyNodeItem(
210      @NonNull IAssemblyDefinition definition,
211      @NonNull IModuleNodeItem metaschema);
212
213  /**
214   * Create a new {@link IAssemblyNodeItem} that is detached from a Metaschema.
215   *
216   * @param definition
217   *          the global definition
218   * @param baseUri
219   *          the base URI to use for this node item when evaluating an
220   *          {@link IMetapathExpression}
221   * @return the new assembly node item
222   */
223  @NonNull
224  IAssemblyNodeItem newAssemblyNodeItem(
225      @NonNull IAssemblyDefinition definition,
226      @Nullable URI baseUri);
227
228  /**
229   * Create a new {@link IAssemblyNodeItem} that is detached from a Metaschema,
230   * with associated data.
231   *
232   * @param definition
233   *          the global definition
234   * @param baseUri
235   *          the base URI to use for this node item when evaluating an
236   *          {@link IMetapathExpression}
237   * @param value
238   *          the associated data
239   * @return the new assembly node item
240   */
241  @NonNull
242  IAssemblyNodeItem newAssemblyNodeItem(
243      @NonNull IAssemblyDefinition definition,
244      @Nullable URI baseUri,
245      @NonNull Object value);
246
247  /**
248   * Create a new {@link IAssemblyNodeItem} that is based on a Metaschema
249   * instance.
250   * <p>
251   * A single instance of this item is expected to represent the possibility in a
252   * metaschema of a series of instance values.
253   *
254   * @param instance
255   *          the Metaschema assembly instance
256   * @param parent
257   *          the parent node item
258   * @return the new assembly node item
259   */
260  @NonNull
261  IAssemblyNodeItem newAssemblyNodeItem(
262      @NonNull IAssemblyInstance instance,
263      @NonNull IAssemblyNodeItem parent);
264
265  /**
266   * Create a new {@link IAssemblyNodeItem} that is based on a Metaschema instance
267   * with associated data.
268   *
269   * @param instance
270   *          the Metaschema assembly instance
271   * @param parent
272   *          the parent node item
273   * @param position
274   *          the data item's position in the sequence of data items for the
275   *          instance, which is {@code 0} based
276   * @param value
277   *          the data item's value
278   * @return the new assembly node item
279   */
280  @NonNull
281  IAssemblyNodeItem newAssemblyNodeItem(
282      @NonNull IAssemblyInstanceGrouped instance,
283      @NonNull IAssemblyNodeItem parent,
284      int position,
285      @NonNull Object value);
286
287  /**
288   * Create a new {@link IAssemblyNodeItem} that is based on a Metaschema instance
289   * with associated data.
290   *
291   * @param instance
292   *          the Metaschema assembly instance
293   * @param parent
294   *          the parent node item
295   * @param position
296   *          the data item's position in the sequence of data items for the
297   *          instance, which is {@code 0} based
298   * @param value
299   *          the data item's value
300   * @return the new assembly node item
301   */
302  @NonNull
303  IAssemblyNodeItem newAssemblyNodeItem(
304      @NonNull IAssemblyInstance instance,
305      @NonNull IAssemblyNodeItem parent,
306      int position,
307      @NonNull Object value);
308}
